instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide-angle full shot. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls, the woman in the white t-shirt (R2) stands on the left-center, profile facing right, reaching her right hand to touch the man's shoulder. The man in the black polo shirt (R1) stands on the right-center, facing slightly left and looking at her. The woman (R2) extends her right arm to touch the right shoulder of the man (R1). Bright overhead fluorescent lighting casts soft shadows across the room.
